segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ הַגּוֹזֵל עֵצִים וַעֲשָׂאָן כֵּלִים, צֶמֶר וַעֲשָׂאָן בְּגָדִים – מְשַׁלֵּם כִּשְׁעַת הַגְּזֵלָה.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» In the case of «one who robs» another of «wood and fashions it» into «vessels,» or one who robs another of «wool and fashions it» into «garments,» he «pays» the robbery victim «according to» the value of the goods at the «time of the robbery,» but he need not return the vessels or garments. He has acquired the stolen items because they had undergone a change.

segments.he: גָּזַל פָּרָה מְעוּבֶּרֶת – וְיָלְדָה, רָחֵל טְעוּנָה – וּגְזָזָהּ; מְשַׁלֵּם דְּמֵי פָרָה הָעוֹמֶדֶת לֵילֵד, וּדְמֵי רָחֵל הָעוֹמֶדֶת לִיגָּזֵז.
segments.en: If one «robbed» another of «a pregnant cow and it» then «gave birth» while in his possession, or if one robbed another of «a ewe» that was «laden» with wool «and» the robber then «sheared it,» the robber «pays» the «value of a cow that is ready to give birth or» the «value of a ewe that is ready to be shorn.» He pays the value of the animal at the time of the robbery, and the calf or the wool remains his.

segments.he: גָּזַל פָּרָה – וְנִתְעַבְּרָה אֶצְלוֹ וְיָלְדָה, רָחֵל – וְנִטְעֲנָה אֶצְלוֹ וּגְזָזָהּ; מְשַׁלֵּם כִּשְׁעַת הַגְּזֵלָה. זֶה הַכְּלָל: כׇּל הַגַּזְלָנִים מְשַׁלְּמִין כִּשְׁעַת הַגְּזֵלָה.
segments.en: If one «robbed» another of «a cow, and it became pregnant in his» possession, «and it» then «gave birth;» or if one robbed another of «a ewe, and it became laden» with wool «in his» possession, «and» he then «sheared it,» then the robber «pays according to» the value of the animal at the «time of the robbery. This is the principle: All robbers pay according to» the value of the stolen item at the «time of the robbery.»

moves.summary: wood made into vessels, wool into garments: pays value at time of robbery
pregnant cow that gave birth, laden ewe that was shorn: pays value of animal ready to give birth or be shorn
became pregnant or laden in his possession: pays as at robbery; general rule for all robbers

positions.claim: all robbers pay according to the value at the time of the robbery; a changed item is acquired by the robber
